summary_1line: Chyavana recounts how the mighty king Mandhata sought universal conquest but was annihilated by the rakshasa Lavana’s divine trident.

image_candidates.scene_text: The rakshasa Lavana hurls his blazing trident, which streaks through the sky and incinerates King Mandhata and his entire army.
Indra confronts the ambitious King Mandhata in the heavens as the king declares his desire to conquer the celestial throne.
A terrified envoy stands before the monstrous Lavana in the forest moments before the demon devours him.
